text:
**Depot:** Fenbury
**Context:**
- Lifts near garden studio, north office, print room, library annex, and harbour room are slow.
- Garden studio, north office, print room, and loading bay (evening) are being repainted; expect noise.
- Stand-ups: Morning (harbour room), Afternoon (east wing), Evening (loading bay).
- Out: Mira, Opal, Rafe, Wren, Vik, Una, Jonah.
- Coverage: Pia (Mira/Opal), Dell (Jonah/Nils/Vik), Greta (Wren), Bram (Una). Note: Vik covers Jonah.
- Visitor requests: Opal, Hugo, Ines, Vik, Una, Suri, Ada want print room, harbour room, garden studio, library annex clear. Una also wants loading bay clear. Leon wants harbour room clear. Ada wants library annex clear. Greta wants north office clear.
- Preferences: Wren (east wing), Kira (print room), Una (north office). Jonah prefers library annex for reviews.
- Desk swaps: Greta/Mira, Opal/Hugo, Opal/Suri, Cora/Nils, Leon/Rafe, Ines/Bram.
- Umbrellas: Garden studio, north office, library annex.
- Cold spots: Wren (loading bay morning), Esme (loading bay evening), Ada (north office evening), Leon (east wing afternoon), Bram (north office morning). Pia thinks print room is too cold in the morning.
- Coffee machines: Garden studio, harbour room, east wing, north office, library annex working.
- Notes to send: Mira, Jonah, Pia, Kira, Bram (evening meeting notes).
- Queries: Greta (harbour room evening), Cora (library annex afternoon), Mira (garden studio evening). Finn asked if loading bay is free in the morning.
- Action items: Check with Pia, Esme, Jonah, Vik. Check with Nils before morning meeting.

**Order:**
- 165 ladders.
- 265 toolkits.
- Flat delivery fee: 45.
